title: A River Becoming: system map
about: Every machine, device, service and connection of A River Becoming at Gray Area, for people and agents. Source of truth for docs/system/index.html (interactive) and docs/system/system.md (generated by tools/system_docs.py). Validated by tools/tests/test_system_json.py. One scenario, 'now' (the page shows a Now/Show switch again only if a second scenario is added). The Agape prototype map (17-21 Oct 2026, scenarios 'now' = Agape and 'show' = Gray Area as planned) is in git history up to commit bdfe5b6. Optional display fields: node.short (diagram name) and link.label (text on the arrow).
rules: Everything except secrets: names, hostnames, LAN and Tailscale IPs, ports, usernames and account emails are in; passwords and token values never (Gavin, 18 Oct).
Secrets appear only by name and where they live.
The river site is given as an area only.

Never advertise a site's own LAN as a Tailscale subnet from another device: it hijacks bitcube's local traffic (18 Oct, when the river router's 10.0.7.0/24 route took the gallery cam away from bitcube). Never advertise 192.168.9.0/24 into a tailnet bitcube is on (D22).

The install LAN never overlaps a range bitcube accepts over Tailscale (today the river router's 192.168.8.0/24): bitcube sends routed ranges into Tailscale even when the same range is local (R15, seen 22 Oct).

The lights never go through the install router (D25): the lighting switch hangs off bitcube's LIGHTS port, so a router reboot or Wi-Fi trouble can't freeze the ropes. S31 (the lighting address moved to the ROUTER port by one command) is the prepared fallback.
verified: confirmed = checked on the device, in code, or by the team; unverified = believed but not checked; awaiting:<Name> = needs that person's answer.

scenarios.name: Now: Gray Area
scenarios.when: since Wed 22 Oct 2026; show to Mon 27 Oct
scenarios.summary: The installation is at Gray Area. The network is done and tested for the ceiling (22-23 Oct, session N): our GL-AXT1800 router (192.168.9.1, Wi-Fi gray-river) gets internet by repeating Gray Area's staff Wi-Fi until the wired drop is connected; bitcube is on the router's LAN2 by the blue cable (192.168.9.79) with Wi-Fi as a 3 s fallback (.80); the gallery cam is on Wi-Fi only (.76: its cable path corrupts every frame, so router port LAN1 is off). bitcube advertises the cam (192.168.9.76/32) and the router (192.168.9.1/32) on Will's tailnet; the router is on Will's tailnet for management (router-gray-area-gl-axt1800) and shared into Gavin's. TouchDesigner boots the local-only seasons show file (river-local-oct-22-seasons.toe, 23 Oct); the Modal link mirrors Dave's scene and posts gallery clips. Not connected until after the lift (S20), so dashed lines and grey dots: the lights (LIGHTS port -> switch -> rack + both PSAC10s -> 20 ropes) and the panels (HDMI -> Colorlight sender -> receive card on the driftwood). The river site is down (no power, S11). Mission control (https://gav-m1-mini.tailddc624.ts.net) shows this map with live status.

nodes.name: bitcube
nodes.summary: The show machine, going into the ceiling grid: a Windows mini PC that runs TouchDesigner, drives the ropes (Art-Net from its LIGHTS port) and the HUB75 (HDMI), reads both cameras, mirrors Modal's scene and posts camera clips. Online at Gray Area since 22 Oct 22:12; recovers by itself after a power cut (tested 22-23 Oct).

specs.boot: BIOS Auto Power On enabled (checked 22 Oct), so it powers on after a power cut; Windows Boot Manager first (Ubuntu still installed); auto-login via Sysinternals Autologon; Tailscale, SSH and TightVNC start before login; no sleep or hibernate; Windows Update paused to 15 Nov; back online about 80 s after power and on its show file within about a minute more
specs.tailscale_routes: advertises 192.168.9.76/32 (gallery cam) + 192.168.9.1/32 (install router admin) on Will's tailnet, approved 22 Oct 22:35; accepts other nodes' routes (RouteAll), so the install LAN must never overlap a routed range (R15)

Mission control's Switch now restarts TD on either
specs.ports_taped: ROUTER = Ethernet 2 (blue tape, to the router's LAN2); LIGHTS = Ethernet (white tape, 2.0.0.8, to the lighting switch). Swapped cables: bitcube stays online over Wi-Fi but the lights stay dark

api.summary: Modal composes, bitcube renders. Every 5 minutes the agent's tick writes a scene (state.json) and status; between ticks, camera reflexes nudge the scene's knobs (reflex.json). bitcube never renders on Modal: it mirrors these small JSON files locally (gallery/sync.py on 127.0.0.1:8770) and draws the scene itself: in the online show file (river-online-oct-23.toe) Modal's scene scales the look and canvas.html plays as a layer, so the show keeps its last scene through an outage. The boot file since 23 Oct, the seasons file, is local-only (R1) and ignores Modal. In the other direction, bitcube pushes 10 s camera clips to /ingest with a bearer token. Nothing on Modal connects into bitcube or the tailnet.

endpoints.auth: None today. With SITE_TOKEN set: cookie river_token=<SITE_TOKEN> (set once by opening any page with ?token=...).

responses.404: not a served file, or not written yet (state.json is never 404: a placeholder scene is served)

params.location: lowercase name matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$; questions are asked only for gallery and river
params.channel: same pattern; video for mp4 clips (fast perception); camera, microphone, hydrophone for frames and WAVs; any other name for JSON readings
params.ext: optional ?ext= when the content type is unknown

endpoints.body: The file. Content-Type one of image/jpeg, image/png, audio/wav, audio/flac, audio/ogg, audio/mpeg, video/mp4, application/json. Max 25 MB. A JSON reading must be an object with a non-empty summary.
endpoints.stores: media/<location>/<channel>/<YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS-mmmZ>.<ext> on the Volume; video kept 1 h, other media 72 h. An mp4 spawns watch() (one at a time, in order).

400.error: location and channel must be short lowercase names

415.error: unknown content type 'text/plain'; send image/jpeg, audio/wav, application/json, or ?ext=

json_reading_example.summary: Water is 11.2 C, down 0.3 since the morning.

params.h: design height, default 270 (w x h is an area; the design takes the window's shape)

endpoints.note: Draws the scene client-side at the window's device pixels; polls status.json every 3 s, state.json on a new tick (or every 30 s), reflex.json every 2 s. Never blank: falls back to a default scene.

files.name: status.json
files.written_by: tick, at the start (in_progress) and end of every tick

fields.next_tick_epoch: when the next tick is due
fields.acted: the tools the agent called this tick
fields.sensors: per site_channel: present, file, age_s, fresh
fields.in_progress: null, or set while a tick runs

notes: A3
D4

files.name: state.json
files.written_by: tick, when the agent calls set_visual_scene
files.poll: on a new tick (or every 30 s)

fields.seq: int, +1 per change (apply only when it changes)
fields.set_at / set_at_epoch: when it was set (used to ease)
fields.scene.animation: drift | flow | ripples | aurora | embers | waves | blooms | pulse

files.name: reflex.json
files.written_by: watch, every few seconds while a camera is answering

fields.ttl_seconds: ignore the file once older than this (default 90)
fields.offsets: brightness, speed, density, turbulence; each clamped to +-0.25, added to the scene's knobs
fields.sites: last reading per site (epoch or null)

files.name: pad.json

fields.state: chord, notes (MIDI), colour (plain|seventh|suspended|open|add9), register (low|middle|high), voices, intensity
fields.events: timed voice moves: expression / on / off at absolute epochs

files.note: The installation will probably have no sound.

fields.entries: oldest first: tick, timestamp, reflection, mood_word, auto_generated, context
